storyText: La Cucina Povera — 'the poor kitchen' — is a love letter to Italian cucina povera cooking. Honest, unfussy food made with the best ingredients. Focaccia baked fresh, stuffed generously, and served with care. No shortcuts, no fuss — just the good stuff.
